help.title: How can we help?
help.searchPh: Search: coins, password, Fast Pass, refund…
help.countFor: {count, plural, one {# article} other {# articles}} for “{q}”
help.noneText: Try other words, or send us a message below.
help.sorry: Sorry. Send us a message below.

articles.a: Fast Pass lets you read the newest episodes before they’re free. Each Fast Pass episode costs 5 coins. Every episode becomes free for everyone 7 days after it comes out.
Go to Coins, pick a pack, and pay with KHQR, ABA Pay or a card. Your first purchase gives you double coins. Coins arrive in a few seconds.
No. Coins you buy never expire. Bonus coins from events may have an end date, which we show when you get them.

articles.q: I paid but didn’t get my coins
articles.a: Most payments confirm within seconds. If it’s been more than 10 minutes, send us a message with your order number (it starts with TW-). We’ll check with the bank and add your coins or refund you.
Coins you haven’t spent can be refunded within the refund period. Coins already spent on episodes can’t be refunded. If you were charged twice or a payment failed, we refund it in full.
articles.link: Read the coins and refunds policy

articles.a: On the Log in page, tap “Forgot password?”, enter your email, and we’ll send you a 6-digit code to set a new password.

articles.q: How do I change my name or language?
articles.a: Open Settings. Your display name is under Account, and the app language (English or ខ្មែរ) is under Language and region.

articles.q: How do I delete my account?
articles.a: Open Settings → Account actions → Delete account. This deletes your library, comments and unused coins, and can’t be undone.

articles.q: Images load slowly or look blurry
articles.a: Check your connection, then set Image quality to Automatic in Settings → Reading. On mobile data, “Data saver” loads smaller images.

articles.q: How do I get alerts for new episodes?
articles.a: Subscribe to a series. You’ll get a notification when a new episode comes out. Choose push or email in Notifications → Alert settings.

articles.q: How do I publish my comic or novel?
articles.a: Open Creator studio → New series, add the details, summary and cover, then submit it for review. We check new series within 1–2 days. Then upload your first episode.

articles.q: What image size should episodes be?
articles.a: Use JPG or PNG, 690–1600 px wide, up to 20 MB per image. Upload them in reading order; you can reorder before publishing.
You earn when readers spend coins on your Fast Pass episodes. Add a payout method in Earnings. Payout amounts and dates follow the creator agreement.

articles.q: How do I report a comment or series?
articles.a: Tap “Report” next to a comment, or “Report it” on a series’ About tab. Choose a reason and send. We review reports within 24 hours. Reports are anonymous.
Tap “Block” next to their comment or on their profile. You won’t see their comments and they can’t reply to you. Unblock them any time in Settings → Privacy and safety.
Turn airplane mode off, then turn Wi-Fi or mobile data off and on again. The page reconnects by itself when you’re back online.
Try refreshing the page or updating your browser. If it still doesn’t work, send us a message with a screenshot and what you were trying to do.
